name: Monster Tutor
source:
n "Monster Tutor" you step into the shoes of a professor unexpectedly sent to teach at Netherworld Academy, a school for monster girls. Right from the start, your job is anything but normal. 

On day one, you meet Azazel, a troublemaker demon; Phanta, a shy ghost; and Josa, a vampire who's not too thrilled about having a human teacher. The game kicks off with you trying to make the best of this weird situation, figuring out how to connect with your students and manage their unique personalities. 

Do you have what it takes to tutor these girls and form a connection with them, despite being the only human in the Netherworld?

[From [url=https://nuteku.itch.io/monster-tutor]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《怪物导师》中，你扮演一位教授，意外地被派往幽冥学院任教，这是一所怪物女孩学校。从一开始，你的工作就绝非正常。

第一天，你遇到了阿萨兹勒，一个制造麻烦的恶魔；Phanta，一个害羞的鬼魂；乔萨是一个吸血鬼，他对有一个人类老师不太高兴。游戏开始时，你试图充分利用这种奇怪的情况，弄清楚如何与你的学生建立联系并管理他们独特的个性。

尽管你是冥界唯一的人类，但你有能力指导这些女孩并与她们建立联系吗？

[来自[url=https://nuteku.itch.io/monster-tutor]Itch.io[/url]]
